How much does alternator replacement cost?

A new alternator, installed — what it costs, and what moves the price:

$809–$1,088
Alternator replacement, national — RepairPal average

Parts $613–$800 · labor $196–$288

Bay Area: no published metro-specific figure found — the national range is the honest reference.

What drives the price

Why quotes run $350 to $1,200+

Four things move the price:

The part
New OEM through a shop: $611–$793. Remanufactured runs less — on a Civic-class car the whole job can land $350–$550.
Vehicle
Economy cars: $350–$550. Trucks and SUVs: $450–$750. European luxury: $600–$1,200+ — the part and the access both cost more.
Labor
Booked at $191–$281 nationally, 1.5–3.5 hours. A buried alternator under the intake doubles the labor; an easy one is an hour.
Dealer vs. independent
Dealers add 30–50% over independents, mostly in parts markup. Same alternator, same job.
New vs. remanufactured

What the extra money buys

Remanufactured
Less

A rebuilt unit with new wear parts, tested. Fine for most daily drivers — the savings are real and the failure mode is the same either way.

New OEM
$100–$300 more

Brand-new from the manufacturer. Worth it on a car you're keeping long-term, or when reman quality is a coin flip for your model.

Bottom line: the part is three-quarters of this bill, so that's where the decision lives. Reman on a commuter, new on a keeper.

Questions

Common questions

How do I know it's the alternator and not the battery?

Dimming lights, a battery warning light, and a car that dies shortly after a jump all point at the alternator. Get the charging system tested before buying parts — the test is usually free.

How long do alternators last?

80,000–150,000 miles. Heat, short trips, and heavy electrical loads shorten it.

Can I drive with a bad alternator?

About 20–30 minutes on battery alone — enough to get off the road, not enough to get home. Don't chance it.

Should the battery be replaced too?

Only if it tests bad. A failing alternator can kill a battery, so test it after the swap — but don't let anyone sell you both on principle.

Every car prices differently.

The range above is a national average. Your price depends on the car and the part you choose. Take a photo of your estimate or the engine bay in Brightglow for a second opinion on the actual car.
